T7.subject: v1_host_edit_family_gate
T7.reason: The pinned OpenCode 1 host picks one edit family from the model id inside its own tool registry, before any plugin is consulted. V1 parity retains its captured mock/mock-model selector, which withholds apply_patch, so this row's V1 leg and cross-host comparison remain excluded. V2 apply_patch scenarios explicitly select openai/gpt-5-mock through scenario.model, with the host patch plugin disabled and AFT's model gate supplying apply_patch instead of edit/write. The V2 leg decides the row: the tool must be registered, called, and its result must match what the scenario declares.
